name: surf_temp_mean_K
label: Mean surface temperature
version: LRO Diviner Polar Resource Product v2 (LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0); NASA PDS: InSight TWINS derived (air temp, wind) + PS calibrated (pressure), 12 sols sampled every 56 sols over sols 123-739; NASA PDS: MSL REMS MODRDR (MSL-M-REMS-5-MODRDR-V1.0), 12 sols sampled every 56 sols over sols 100-716; NASA PDS: Mars 2020 MEDA calibrated env (ATS air temp, PS pressure, WS wind), 12 sols sampled every 56 sols over sols 15-631; wind from 5 sols (sensor damaged ~sol 489); NASA PDS: Phoenix MET reduced RDR 512-s averages, 69 sols; 151-sol northern-summer mission only - biased warm vs true annual mean; NASA PDS: Viking Lander 1 binned met (VL1-M-MET-4-BINNED-P-T-V-CORR-V1.0), 333 sols; dust tau from VL1 camera opacity (504 obs); temp at 1.6 m boom
note: Moon: modelled annual average at 2 cm depth. Mars: annual mean from the climate database.

name: shallow_ice_share
label: Area with ice stable in the top metre
version: LRO Diviner Polar Resource Product v2 (LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0)
note: Share of the site where water ice would survive within 1 m of the surface.

name: subsurface_h2o_share
label: Water in the shallow subsurface
version: Mars Odyssey GRS element concentration maps (ODY-M-GRS-5-ELEMENTS-V1.0), smoothed 5x5 deg
note: Water-equivalent hydrogen in roughly the top metre, as a weight fraction, from Odyssey GRS neutron data. 5x5 degree bins, so a regional value around the site.

name: slope_deg
label: Mean slope
version: LRO Diviner Polar Resource Product v2 (LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0); MGS MOLA MEGDR 16 px/deg topography (MGS-M-MOLA-5-MEGDR-L3-V1.0)
note: Moon: slope of the Diviner surface triangles. Mars: slope over a 3.7 km baseline. Baselines differ.

name: roughness_deg
label: Terrain roughness
version: LRO Diviner Polar Resource Product v2 (LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0); MGS MOLA MEGDR 16 px/deg topography (MGS-M-MOLA-5-MEGDR-L3-V1.0)
note: Spread (standard deviation) of slope inside the site radius: how broken the ground is. Moon: across Diviner surface triangles. Mars: across MOLA grid cells. Baselines differ.

name: relief_m
label: Relief within the site
version: LRO Diviner Polar Resource Product v2 (LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0); MGS MOLA MEGDR 16 px/deg topography (MGS-M-MOLA-5-MEGDR-L3-V1.0)
note: Standard deviation of elevation inside the site radius.

name: surf_pressure_Pa
label: Surface pressure
version: MGS MOLA MEGDR 16 px/deg topography (MGS-M-MOLA-5-MEGDR-L3-V1.0); NASA PDS: InSight TWINS derived (air temp, wind) + PS calibrated (pressure), 12 sols sampled every 56 sols over sols 123-739; NASA PDS: MSL REMS MODRDR (MSL-M-REMS-5-MODRDR-V1.0), 12 sols sampled every 56 sols over sols 100-716; NASA PDS: Mars 2020 MEDA calibrated env (ATS air temp, PS pressure, WS wind), 12 sols sampled every 56 sols over sols 15-631; wind from 5 sols (sensor damaged ~sol 489); NASA PDS: Phoenix MET reduced RDR 512-s averages, 69 sols; 151-sol northern-summer mission only - biased warm vs true annual mean; NASA PDS: Viking Lander 1 binned met (VL1-M-MET-4-BINNED-P-T-V-CORR-V1.0), 333 sols; dust tau from VL1 camera opacity (504 obs); temp at 1.6 m boom
note: Mars: from the climate database where entered, otherwise estimated from MOLA elevation as 610 Pa x exp(-elevation / 10.8 km); it also varies by roughly a quarter over the Martian year. Moon: set to 0 (no atmosphere), a physical prior.

name: elevation_m
label: Elevation
version: LRO Diviner Polar Resource Product v2 (LRO-L-DLRE-5-PRP-V2.0); MGS MOLA MEGDR 16 px/deg topography (MGS-M-MOLA-5-MEGDR-L3-V1.0)
note: Measured from each body’s own reference surface.
